entries.title: Utopian Society v3 civic platform published
entries.summary: Version 3 unifies the public corpus and civic portal as one production experience. The release introduces private citizen profiles and public civic profiles; Circle-facing civic interfaces; a source-bound, cumulative Ten-Q Learning evidence system with contracts, OCR review, recourse, and document-specific evaluation; expanded Immigration intake, assessment, oath, certificate, and citizen-record pathways; seven Foundational Circles and their civic topology; new Lore including Birth of the Moon and 9 Kingdoms Solitaire; population, Balance, FTB, and civic-status surfaces; read-aloud access and Utopian publication dates; robots.txt and an 84-route sitemap; and encrypted R2 storage for protected civic files.
entries.sourceLabel: The Utopian Society v3 public release
